# Global Ag Trade Show Map & 2027 Calendar (events.duess.com)

> Free, zero-login interactive world map and 2027 calendar of USDA-endorsed agricultural trade shows (USA Pavilions), official 2027 USDA FAS Agribusiness Trade Missions, and major global food exhibitions, built for USAEDC members and FAS cooperators by Duess Strategies Inc.

## What It Covers (39 Events Across 23 Countries)

- **26 USDA-Endorsed Trade Shows (USA Pavilions):** ISM Cologne (Jan 31-Feb 3), Fruit Logistica Berlin (Feb 3-5), Wine Paris (Feb 15-17), BIOFACH Nuremberg (Feb 16-19), FOODEX Japan Tokyo (Mar 9-12), Gulfood Dubai (Mar 15-19), Food & Hotel Vietnam (Mar 24-26), FHA Singapore (Apr 20-23), SIAL Canada Toronto (Apr 27-29), Expo ANTAD Guadalajara (Apr 27-29), SIAL Shanghai (May), THAIFEX - Anuga Asia Bangkok (May 25-29), Seoul Food & Hotel (Jun 8-11), Food Taipei (Jun 23-26), SIAL India Mumbai (Jun 24-26), Food & Hotel Indonesia (Jul 21-24), SMTS Fresh Solution Tokyo (Jul 28-30), Fi Asia Thailand (Sep 1-3), Fine Food Australia Sydney (Sep 6-9), Asia Fruit Logistica Hong Kong (Sep 7-9), Expo Alimentaria Peru (Sep 22-24), Americas Food & Beverage Miami (Sep 27-29), Anuga Cologne (Oct 9-13), Gulfood Manufacturing Dubai (Nov 1-3), FHC Shanghai (Nov), and Fi Europe Paris (Nov 30-Dec 2).
- **6 Official 2027 USDA FAS Agribusiness Trade Missions:** Costa Rica, Ecuador, Poland, South Korea, Thailand, and Venezuela.
- **7 Major Global Industry Staples:** ProWein (Düsseldorf), VIV Asia (Bangkok), Dubai WoodShow, Seafood Expo Global (Barcelona), Petfood Forum (Kansas City), SPACE (Rennes), and Fruit Attraction (Madrid).

## Key Features

- Interactive Natural Earth vector world map with regional zoom (Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East & Africa, Americas) and commodity sector filters.
- 12-month 2027 show-density timeline with FAS / USAEDC planning windows.
- Custom "My 2027 Schedule" builder with single or bulk RFC 5545 `.ics` calendar export (Outlook, Google Calendar, Apple Calendar), CSV export for travel budgets, and shareable shortlist URLs (`?saved=...`).

## Direct Deep Links

- Full map & calendar: https://events.duess.com/
- Filter by region: `https://events.duess.com/?region=Europe` (or `Asia-Pacific`, `Americas`, `Middle+East+%26+Africa`)
- Filter by type: `https://events.duess.com/?type=endorsed` or `https://events.duess.com/?type=mission`
- Filter by commodity sector: `https://events.duess.com/?sector=Fresh+Produce+%26+Tree+Nuts`

## Freshness

Audited on the 1st of every month via GitHub Actions for newly announced 2027 Trade Mission dates, TBD shows, and organizer link updates, with automatic Cloudflare Pages deployment on updates.
